stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 13 hours and pipe B can fill it in 6 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/13$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/6$. Combined rate $= 1/13 + 1/6 = 0.2436$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/13+1/6} = 4.11$ hours.
